auth.messages.candidateExpired.en: Candidate account is no longer active. Candidate access lasts only {days} days.
auth.messages.candidateExpired.id: Akun kandidat sudah tidak aktif. Masa akses kandidat hanya {days} hari.

auth.messages.sessionExpired.en: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
auth.messages.sessionExpired.id: Sesi Anda telah berakhir. Silahkan Login kembali.

auth.messages.accountInactive.en: Your account is inactive. Please contact the administrator.
auth.messages.accountInactive.id: Akun Anda sedang tidak aktif. Silakan hubungi administrator.

auth.messages.candidateExpiryUpdateFaile.en: Failed to deactivate the expired candidate account.
auth.messages.candidateExpiryUpdateFaile.id: Gagal menonaktifkan akun kandidat yang sudah kedaluwarsa.

forgotPassword.description.en: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.description.id: Masukkan alamat email Anda dan kami akan mengirimkan tautan untuk mengatur ulang kata sandi.

forgotPassword.validation.invalidEmail.en: Please enter a valid email address.
forgotPassword.validation.invalidEmail.id: Silakan masukkan alamat email yang valid.

forgotPassword.messages.emailSent.en: Password reset link has been sent to your email. Please check your inbox.
forgotPassword.messages.emailSent.id: Tautan reset kata sandi telah dikirim ke email Anda. Silakan periksa kotak masuk Anda.

forgotPassword.messages.failed.en: Failed to send reset link. Please try again.
forgotPassword.messages.failed.id: Gagal mengirim tautan reset. Silakan coba lagi.

resetPassword.invalidToken.id: Token Tidak Valid atau Sudah Kadaluarsa

resetPassword.invalidTokenDescription.en: The password reset link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
resetPassword.invalidTokenDescription.id: Tautan reset kata sandi tidak valid atau sudah kadaluarsa. Silakan minta yang baru.

resetPassword.successDescription.en: Your password has been reset successfully. You can now log in with your new password.
resetPassword.successDescription.id: Kata sandi Anda telah berhasil diatur ulang. Anda sekarang dapat masuk dengan kata sandi baru Anda.

resetPassword.messages.failed.en: Failed to reset password. Please try again.
resetPassword.messages.failed.id: Gagal mengatur ulang kata sandi. Silakan coba lagi.
